title: 设备维护与可靠性
Maintenance and Reliability
goals: 能用浴盆曲线说明失效率的三个阶段，判断预防性保养对哪一段有用。
Use the bathtub curve to explain the three phases of the failure rate and say which phase preventive maintenance helps.
能写出威布尔分布的 F(t)、R(t)、h(t)，说明 β、η 的含义，算出 MTTF。
Write F(t), R(t) and h(t) of the Weibull distribution, explain β and η, and compute the MTTF.
能算出已运行 t 小时的设备未来 H 小时坏掉的条件概率和预期损失，并与保养花费、交期一起比较方案。
Compute the conditional probability that a machine which has run t hours fails in the next H hours, and the expected loss, and compare options together with service cost and delivery.
能用按龄保养的平均花费 C(T) 求最优保养周期，解释保养成本对它的影响。
Find the optimal service interval from the age-based cost rate C(T) and explain how the service cost affects it.
能在数字工厂里完成一次保养决策：手算、选方案、发起保养工单、验收，并用故障记录估 MTBF。
Carry out a maintenance decision in the digital factory: calculate, choose, raise the service order, accept it, and estimate MTBF from failure records.

title: 磨床保养逾期 120 小时，急单在赶，停不停？
The grinder is 120 hours overdue and a rush order is running: stop it or not?
text: 外圆磨床 GRD-01 是全厂瓶颈，机器人厂追加的关节减速器齿轮轴都要过它。它的保养周期 500 运行小时，现在已运行 620 小时。可靠性模型：威布尔分布 β = 3、η = 900 h。坏一次停 8 小时，修理 $1,200，停机每小时少挣 $200；保养一次停 3 小时，人工和材料 $215。车间主任说先赶急单，设备员说必须马上停。

Cylindrical grinder GRD-01 is the plant's bottleneck; every gear shaft of the robot plant's extra joint-reducer order passes through it. Its service interval is 500 operating hours and it has now run 620. Reliability model: Weibull, β = 3, η = 900 h. A failure stops it for 8 hours, costs $1,200 to repair and loses $200 of margin per hour; a service stops it for 3 hours and costs $215 in labour and materials. The supervisor wants to finish the rush order first; the maintenance planner wants to stop now.
question: 未来 80 运行小时不保养坏掉的概率和预期损失是多少？不停、现在停、下班后停，哪个最划算？保养周期 500 h 定得对吗？

Without service, what are the probability of failing in the next 80 operating hours and the expected loss? Which is cheapest: don't stop, stop now, or stop after the shift? Is the 500 h interval right?
answer: P = 1 − exp{−[(700/900)³ − (620/900)³]} = 13.4%，预期损失 0.134 × $2,800 = $375。三个方案的预期合计：不做 $375，现在保养 $817（含停瓶颈 3 小时少挣 $600），下班后保养 $235。建议下班后保养，风险降到 0.07%。若保养都放在下班后，最优周期约 312 h（每运行小时 $1.04，现行 500 h 为 $1.30）；若在生产时间里停机保养，最优约 535 h，500 h 已接近最优。

P = 1 − exp{−[(700/900)³ − (620/900)³]} = 13.4%, expected loss 0.134 × $2,800 = $375. Expected totals: do nothing $375, service now $817 (including $600 of margin lost while the bottleneck stops for 3 hours), service after the shift $235. Service after the shift; the risk drops to 0.07%. If services are always done after the shift, the optimal interval is about 312 h ($1.04 per operating hour, against $1.30 at 500 h); if they stop production, the optimum is about 535 h and 500 h is already close.

title: 机器人联系：关节减速器的换脂与状态监测
Robot link: regreasing joint reducers and condition monitoring
text: 协作机器人每个关节里都有一台精密减速器，润滑脂老化、轴承和齿面磨损，是典型的 β > 1。设润滑相关失效 β = 2.5、η = 20,000 h（示意值）：已经运行 14,000 h 的关节，再跑 2,000 h 坏掉的概率 15.0%，刚换过脂的只有 0.3%，所以厂家按运行小时规定换脂周期。机器人控制器还能读到关节电机电流，摩擦力矩慢慢变大就是减速器在磨损，据此安排保养叫状态监测，比按龄保养更省。我们的工厂造的 WQR-105 正是装进这些关节的减速器。

Each joint of a collaborative robot contains a precision reducer whose grease ages and whose bearings and teeth wear: a typical β > 1. With β = 2.5 and η = 20,000 h for lubrication failures (illustrative values), a joint that has run 14,000 h has a 15.0% chance of failing in the next 2,000 h, against 0.3% right after regreasing, which is why manufacturers specify regreasing by operating hours. The controller can also read each joint motor's current: a slowly rising friction torque means the reducer is wearing, and scheduling service from it is condition monitoring, cheaper than age-based service. The WQR-105 reducers our plant makes go into exactly these joints.

title: 生活例子：汽车多久换一次机油
Everyday example: how often to change a car's oil
text: 说明书写每 5,000 公里换机油。拖到 8,000 公里多半也没事，可发动机坏一次的钱够换几十次油；什么时候换油，比的就是“概率 × 损失”和“确定的小花费”。反过来，手机芯片几乎不磨损（β ≈ 1），没人会定期更换它。

The manual says change the oil every 5,000 km. Stretching it to 8,000 km is usually fine, but one engine failure costs as much as dozens of oil changes; deciding when to change it is weighing probability × loss against a small, certain cost. Conversely, a phone's chips hardly wear (β ≈ 1), and nobody replaces them on schedule.

title: 实际问题：磨床保养逾期，停不停？
The problem: the grinder is overdue. Stop it or not?
points: GRD-01 是瓶颈，已运行 620 h，周期 500 h
GRD-01 is the bottleneck: run 620 h, interval 500 h
坏一次：停 8 h、修理 $1,200、每小时少挣 $200
One failure: 8 h down, $1,200 repair, $200 lost per hour
保养一次：停 3 h、人工材料 $215
One service: 3 h down, $215 labour and materials
narration: 先看厂里出的事。外圆磨床 GRD-01 是全厂瓶颈，机器人厂追加的关节减速器齿轮轴都要过它。保养周期 500 小时，现在已经跑了 620 小时，逾期 120 小时。车间主任说急单要紧，保养往后放；设备员说已经逾期，必须马上停。两个人都有道理，可都没有数字。这一讲我们要算出：不保养，未来 80 小时坏掉的概率多大，预期损失多少，三个方案哪个最划算。

Here's what happened in the plant. Grinder GRD-01 is the bottleneck, and every gear shaft of the robot plant's extra order passes through it. Its interval is 500 hours and it has run 620, 120 hours overdue. The supervisor says the rush order comes first; the planner says it must stop now. Both have a point, and neither has a number. Today we'll calculate the chance of failing in the next 80 hours without service, the expected loss, and which of three options is cheapest.

title: 浴盆曲线：失效率的三个阶段
The bathtub curve: three phases
points: 早期失效：失效率下降，靠磨合和验收
Infant mortality: falling rate; run-in and acceptance tests
偶然失效：失效率不变，保养帮不上
Random failures: constant rate; service doesn't help
磨损失效：失效率上升，保养对付的正是这一段
Wear-out: rising rate; this is what service fights
narration: 设备已经用了 t 小时还没坏，接下来每小时坏掉的概率，叫失效率。大量统计表明它分三段，像个浴盆。新设备早期失效多，失效率往下走，这要靠磨合和验收，拆得越勤反而越容易出问题。中间一段失效率大致不变，坏不坏看外因，保养帮不上。最后是磨损期，轴承、导轨、密封越用越磨，失效率往上走。预防性保养对付的正是这一段。

The failure rate is the chance per hour that a machine which has survived t hours fails next. Statistics show it has three phases, like a bathtub. New machines suffer infant mortality and the rate falls; the cure is run-in and acceptance tests, and frequent dismantling only makes it worse. In the middle the rate is roughly constant; failures come from outside, and service doesn't help. Finally comes wear-out: bearings, guides and seals wear and the rate rises. That is the phase preventive maintenance fights.

title: 威布尔分布：两个参数
The Weibull distribution: two parameters
points: β 管形状：<1 下降，=1 不变，>1 上升
β sets the shape: <1 falling, =1 constant, >1 rising
η 管尺度：t = η 时 F = 63.2%
η sets the scale: F = 63.2% at t = η
MTTF = ηΓ(1+1/β)；GRD-01 为 804 h
MTTF = ηΓ(1+1/β); 804 h for GRD-01
narration: 工程上最常用的寿命模型是威布尔分布。F(t) 是运行到 t 之前坏掉的概率，对它求导再除以可靠度，就是失效率 h(t)。形状参数 β 决定失效率怎么变：小于 1 往下走，等于 1 不变，大于 1 往上走，机械磨损一般在 2 到 4 之间。尺度参数 η 叫特征寿命，不管 β 是多少，到 η 时累计故障概率都是 63.2%。磨床 β 等于 3、η 等于 900 小时，平均寿命 804 小时。

The most common life model in engineering is the Weibull distribution. F(t) is the probability of failing before t; differentiate it and divide by the reliability and you get the failure rate h(t). The shape parameter beta sets how the rate changes: below one it falls, at one it's constant, above one it rises, and mechanical wear usually sits between two and four. The scale parameter eta is the characteristic life: whatever beta is, the failure probability at eta is 63.2 percent. Our grinder has beta three and eta 900 hours, a mean life of 804 hours.

title: GRD-01：越用越容易坏
GRD-01: the longer it runs, the likelier it fails
points: Failure rate: 0.37 at 300 h, 1.58 at 620 h (per 1000 h)
翻了四倍多：β = 3 的磨损
More than four times: wear-out with β = 3
narration: 看磨床的两条曲线。左边累计故障概率：到保养周期 500 小时是 15.8%，现在 620 小时是 27.9%，800 小时就过半了。右边失效率：300 小时时每千小时 0.37 次，到 620 小时涨到 1.58 次，翻了四倍多。这就是 β 等于 3 的意思：越用越容易坏。

Here are the grinder's two curves. On the left, the failure probability: 15.8 percent at the 500-hour interval, 27.9 percent now at 620 hours, and past half by 800. On the right, the failure rate: 0.37 per thousand hours at 300 hours, rising to 1.58 at 620, more than four times as much. That's what beta three means: the longer it runs, the likelier it fails.

title: 要的是条件概率
What we need is a conditional probability
points: 到现在没坏是已知的；要的是“再跑 H 小时坏掉”
It hasn't failed so far; we need 'fails within H more hours'
Serviced now: P(0, 80) = 0.07%, 191 times smaller
narration: 做决定要的不是 F(620)，到现在没坏我们已经知道了。要的是：已经跑了 t 小时没坏，再跑 H 小时内坏掉的概率。用条件概率，就是 1 减 R(t+H) 比 R(t)。代进去，700 比 900 的立方减 620 比 900 的立方，等于 0.1436，P 等于 13.4%。如果现在保养，时钟拨回零，未来 80 小时只有 0.07%，小了 191 倍。

A decision doesn't need F of 620; we already know it hasn't failed. We need the chance that a machine which has run t hours without failing fails within the next H. That's a conditional probability: one minus R of t plus H over R of t. Put in the numbers: 700 over 900 cubed minus 620 over 900 cubed is 0.1436, so P is 13.4 percent. Service it now and the clock goes back to zero: 0.07 percent for the next 80 hours, 191 times smaller.

title: β = 1：保养没有用
β = 1: service is useless
points: t 消掉了：P = 1 − e^(−H/η)
t cancels out: P = 1 − e^(−H/η)
用了 620 h 和刚保养完：都是 9.5%
Run 620 h or just serviced: both 9.5%
偶然失效靠防护、监测、备机
Random failures need protection, monitoring, standby
narration: 有个特例值得记住。β 等于 1 时，指数里的 t 消掉了，P 只和 H 有关。用了 620 小时的设备和刚保养完的设备，未来 80 小时坏掉的概率一模一样，取 η 等于 804 小时都是 9.5%。这叫无记忆性。所以偶然失效不能靠定期保养，要靠防护、状态监测或者备机。

One special case is worth remembering. When beta is one, t cancels in the exponent and P depends only on H. A machine that has run 620 hours and one just serviced have exactly the same chance of failing in the next 80 hours: 9.5 percent each with eta of 804. That's called memorylessness. So random failures can't be fought with scheduled service; you need protection, condition monitoring or a standby machine.

title: 预期损失 = 概率 × 一次的损失
Expected loss = probability × loss per failure
points: One failure: $1,200 repair + 8 h × $200 = $2,800
Expected loss without service: 13.4% × $2,800 = $375
这是期望值：多半没事，少数时候赔 $2,800
An expectation: usually nothing, sometimes $2,800
narration: 把概率变成钱。磨床坏一次，修理 1200 美元，停 8 小时，它是瓶颈，每小时少挣 200，合计 2800。不保养的预期损失就是 13.4% 乘 2800，约 375 美元。要注意，这是期望值，不是一定会花的钱：多半什么也不发生，少数时候一下子赔 2800。如果一次故障会让关键客户违约，就要把违约损失算进去。

Now turn probability into money. One failure of the grinder costs a 1,200-dollar repair plus 8 hours stopped; it's the bottleneck, so that's 200 an hour, 2,800 in all. The expected loss without service is 13.4 percent of 2,800, about 375 dollars. Careful: that's an expectation, not money you'll certainly spend. Usually nothing happens; occasionally you lose 2,800 at once. If one failure would make you miss a key customer's delivery, add that penalty in.

title: 三个方案，算一算
Three options, priced
points: A 不做：预期 $375；坏了急单可能晚交
A do nothing: $375 expected; a failure may delay the rush order
B service now: $215 + $600 lost + $2 = $817
C after the shift: $215 + $18 + $2 = $235, cheapest
narration: 厂情中枢给三个方案。A 不做，预期 375 美元，而且一旦坏了要停 8 小时，急单可能晚交。B 现在保养，保养费 215，再加瓶颈停 3 小时少挣 600，合计约 817。C 下班后保养，先再跑 4 小时，这期间坏掉的概率只有 0.63%，合计约 235。C 最划算：风险几乎降到零，又不占瓶颈的生产时间。车间主任和设备员各对了一半。

The factory hub offers three options. A, do nothing: 375 dollars expected, and if it fails it's down for 8 hours and the rush order may slip. B, service now: 215 for the service plus 600 of margin lost while the bottleneck stops for 3 hours, about 817. C, service after the shift: it runs 4 more hours first, with only a 0.63 percent chance of failing meanwhile, about 235 in all. C is cheapest: the risk drops to almost nothing and the bottleneck loses no production time. The supervisor and the planner were each half right.

title: 保养周期怎样定：按龄保养
Choosing the interval: age-based maintenance
points: 到 T 小时就保养；之前坏了就修好重新计时
Service at T hours; if it fails first, repair and restart
太短：保养费占大头；太长：故障损失占大头
Too short: service costs dominate; too long: failures dominate
T → ∞：坏了再修，每小时 $3.48
T → ∞: run to failure, $3.48 per hour
narration: 再往前一步：规矩该怎么定，周期取多少？常用的策略叫按龄保养：跑到 T 小时就保养，之前坏了就修好重新计时。一个周期里，以概率 R(T) 撑到 T、花保养费，以概率 F(T) 中途坏掉、花故障损失；周期的平均长度是 R 从 0 到 T 的积分。两者一除，就是长期每运行小时的平均花费 C(T)。T 趋于无穷，就是坏了再修，磨床每小时 3.48 美元。

One step further: what should the rule be, how long the interval? A common policy is age-based maintenance: service at T hours, and if it fails first, repair it and restart the clock. In each cycle, with probability R of T it reaches T and you pay for a service; with probability F of T it fails on the way and you pay for a failure. The average cycle length is the integral of R from zero to T. Divide one by the other and you get C of T, the long-run cost per operating hour. As T goes to infinity that's run to failure: 3.48 dollars an hour for the grinder.

title: 最优周期取决于保养有多贵
The optimum depends on how dear a service is
points: After the shift ($215): T* = 312 h, $1.04/h, 70% saved
Stopping production ($815): T* = 535 h, $2.34/h
改做法比调参数更值钱
Changing how you work beats tuning a parameter
narration: 画出 C(T)。蓝线是下班后保养，保养只花 215，最优周期 312 小时，每小时 1.04 美元，比坏了再修省七成；现行 500 小时是 1.30，偏长。橙线是生产时间里停机保养，每次再加少挣的 600，保养变贵，最优周期往后移到 535 小时，现行 500 小时几乎就是最优。两条线说明：保养越便宜越该勤；把保养挪到下班后，比调周期省得多。

Here's C of T. The blue curve is servicing after the shift, only 215 a time: the optimum is 312 hours at 1.04 dollars an hour, seventy percent below run to failure; the current 500 hours costs 1.30, too long. The orange curve is stopping production for each service, 600 more of lost margin: service is dearer and the optimum moves out to 535 hours, so 500 is practically optimal. Lesson: the cheaper the service, the more often you do it, and moving service out of production time saves far more than tuning the interval.

title: 用故障记录检验：MTBF
Checking with failure records: MTBF
points: MTBF ≈ 运行小时 ÷ 故障次数：30 × 16 ÷ 3 = 160 h
MTBF ≈ hours ÷ failures: 30 × 16 ÷ 3 = 160 h
记录多了拟合 β、η，再重算周期
With more records, fit β and η and recompute the interval
分清概率和这一次的结果
Keep probability and a single outcome apart
narration: β 和 η 从哪里来？从故障记录来。最简单的是平均故障间隔 MTBF：近 30 天、每天 16 运行小时、坏了 3 次，就是 160 小时。它只是个平均数，看不出失效率升还是降；记录多了，用每次故障时自上次保养以来的小时数拟合威布尔分布，再回头重算周期。还要分清概率和这一次的结果：13% 的风险，十台里一两台会坏。没坏不证明不保养是对的。

Where do beta and eta come from? From failure records. The simplest measure is mean time between failures: 30 days at 16 hours a day with 3 failures gives 160 hours. It's only an average and can't tell whether the rate is rising; with more records, fit a Weibull to the hours since last service at each failure and recompute the interval. And keep probability apart from one outcome: with a 13 percent risk, one or two machines in ten will fail. Not failing doesn't prove skipping the service was right.

title: 在数字工厂里做：实验 18
In the digital factory: Lab 18
points: 任务 1 手算概率与预期损失，平台核对
Task 1: hand-calculate probability and expected loss; the platform checks
任务 2 比较三个方案、提交后再看中枢建议
Task 2: compare three options; see the hub's advice only after submitting
任务 3–5 保养工单、挂牌上锁、验收；对比、估 MTBF
Tasks 3–5: service order, lockout, acceptance; compare, estimate MTBF
narration: 最后到数字工厂里亲手做一次。车间里 13 台设备每台都有自己的威布尔参数，就是我们刚才用的模型，设备真会按这个概率坏。实验 18 先手算逾期设备的概率和预期损失，平台核对；再在指挥台比较三个方案，选一个写理由，提交之前看不到中枢的推荐；然后发起保养工单，老师批准，挂牌上锁、保养、验收解锁；最后车间继续跑，对比保养过和没保养的设备各坏了几次，估 MTBF。

Finally, do it yourself in the digital factory. Each of the 13 machines on the floor has its own Weibull parameters, the same model we just used, and they really do fail with those probabilities. In Lab 18 you first hand-calculate the overdue machine's probability and expected loss, and the platform checks it. Then you compare the three options in the command centre, choose one and give reasons; you can't see the hub's recommendation until you submit. Then you raise the service order, the instructor approves it, and you go through lockout, service and acceptance. Finally the shop keeps running: count failures on serviced and unserviced machines and estimate MTBF.

summary: 失效率 h(t) 分早期失效、偶然失效、磨损失效三段（浴盆曲线），预防性保养只对磨损段有用。
The failure rate h(t) has three phases, infant mortality, random failures and wear-out (the bathtub curve); preventive maintenance only helps in wear-out.
威布尔分布 F(t) = 1 − exp[−(t/η)^β]：β < 1 失效率下降、= 1 不变、> 1 上升；t = η 时 F = 63.2%；MTTF = ηΓ(1 + 1/β)。
Weibull: F(t) = 1 − exp[−(t/η)^β]; the failure rate falls for β < 1, stays constant for β = 1 and rises for β > 1; F = 63.2% at t = η; MTTF = ηΓ(1 + 1/β).
决策用条件概率 P(t, H) = 1 − exp{−[((t+H)/η)^β − (t/η)^β]}，预期损失 = P × C_f；β = 1 时 P 与 t 无关，定期保养无用。
Decisions use P(t, H) = 1 − exp{−[((t+H)/η)^β − (t/η)^β]} and expected loss = P × C_f; for β = 1, P does not depend on t and scheduled service is useless.
比较方案时把确定花费、故障风险和交期放在一起；瓶颈停机的钱要算进去；期望值不够时把违约损失计入或设为硬约束。
Compare options on certain cost, failure risk and delivery together; count the lost margin of a stopped bottleneck; when expectations are not enough, add penalties or make delivery a hard constraint.
按龄保养的 C(T) 有最优周期 T*，保养越便宜周期越短；把保养挪出生产时间往往比调周期更省；用 MTBF 和威布尔拟合检验策略。
Age-based C(T) has an optimal interval T*; the cheaper the service, the shorter T*; moving service out of production time often saves more than tuning T; check the policy with MTBF and Weibull fits.

title: 威布尔可靠性：设备还能撑多久
Weibull reliability: how long will the machine last?
goal: 看清 β、η 怎样改变累计故障概率 F(t) 和失效率 h(t)。
See how β and η change the failure probability F(t) and failure rate h(t).
读出并核对条件故障概率 P(t, H) 和预期损失，理解保养把时钟拨回零。
Read and check the conditional probability P(t, H) and the expected loss, and see how service resets the clock.
通过 β = 1 对照理解无记忆性。
Understand memorylessness through the β = 1 check.
theory: P(t, H) = 1 − exp{−[((t+H)/η)^β − (t/η)^β]}：已运行 t 小时没坏，再运行 H 小时内坏掉的概率。
P(t, H) = 1 − exp{−[((t+H)/η)^β − (t/η)^β]}: the chance that a machine which has run t hours fails within H more.
预期损失 = P × 一次故障的损失（修理费 + 停机少挣的毛利）。
Expected loss = P × loss per failure (repair + lost margin while stopped).
运行时钟动画：每小时按条件概率抽签决定坏不坏；到保养周期就保养，时钟归零。
Clock animation: each hour a draw with the conditional probability decides whether it fails; at the interval it is serviced and the clock resets.
steps: Open the lab and press the GRD-01 preset; check β = 3, η = 900, t = 620, H = 80, loss $2,800.
读出 F(t)、h(t)、未来 H 小时坏掉的概率、刚保养完的概率和预期损失，记入表格，与教材 6.4 节手算核对。
Read F(t), h(t), the probability for the next H hours, the probability right after service and the expected loss; record them and check against Section 6.4.
把 t 从 0 拖到 1600 h，每 200 h 记一次 P，看 P 怎样随 t 变。
Drag t from 0 to 1600 h, recording P every 200 h, and watch how P changes with t.
点“现在保养”，记下 P 降到多少，算出降低的倍数。
Press “Service now”, record the new P and work out the ratio.
点“β = 1 对照”，再拖 t，观察 P 是否变化；在报告里解释。
Press “β = 1 check”, drag t again and see whether P changes; explain in your report.
恢复 GRD-01，点“播放”运行 30 秒，记下保养次数和故障次数；把保养周期改成 300 h、800 h 各播放 30 秒，记录比较。
Restore GRD-01, play for 30 seconds and record services and failures; repeat with intervals of 300 h and 800 h and compare.
点“CNC-L01-A”预置，把 t 设为 700，比较它与 GRD-01 的 P 和预期损失。
Press the CNC-L01-A preset, set t to 700 and compare its P and expected loss with GRD-01's.

caption: 表 1　条件故障概率与预期损失
Table 1  Conditional failure probability and expected loss

questions: t 越大，P(t, H) 越大，这在 β 取什么值时成立？为什么？
For which values of β does P(t, H) grow with t? Why?
同样逾期，为什么 GRD-01 比 CNC-L01-A 更值得马上处理？
Both are overdue: why does GRD-01 deserve attention sooner than CNC-L01-A?
播放时同样的周期，不同次运行坏的次数不同。这说明什么？怎样判断一个保养周期好不好？
With the same interval, different runs show different numbers of failures. What does that tell you, and how should an interval be judged?

title: 保养周期怎样定
Choosing the service interval
goal: 画出按龄保养的长期平均花费 C(T)，找到最优周期 T*。
Plot the long-run cost C(T) of age-based maintenance and find the optimal interval T*.
分析保养成本、故障损失和 β 对最优周期的影响。
Analyse how the service cost, the failure loss and β affect the optimum.
用两台设备的模拟比赛，看长期平均花费怎样收敛到 C(T)。
Use a simulated race between two machines to see the long-run average converge to C(T).
theory: C(T) = [C_p·R(T) + C_f·F(T)] ÷ ∫₀ᵀ R(t) dt：一个周期的期望花费除以周期的平均长度。
C(T) = [C_p·R(T) + C_f·F(T)] ÷ ∫₀ᵀ R(t) dt: expected cost per cycle divided by the mean cycle length.
T → ∞ 时 C(T) → C_f ÷ MTTF，即坏了再修。
As T → ∞, C(T) → C_f ÷ MTTF, i.e. run to failure.
β ≤ 1 时 C(T) 单调下降，没有最优周期。
For β ≤ 1, C(T) only falls and there is no optimum.
模拟：每台设备的寿命按威布尔分布抽样，两台用同一串随机数，只有策略不同。
Simulation: lifetimes are drawn from the Weibull distribution; both machines use the same random numbers and differ only in policy.
steps: Open the lab and press “service after shift” (β = 3, η = 900, C_p = $215, C_f = $2,800, T = 500).
读出 T*、C(T*)、T = 500 h 时的 C(T) 和坏了再修的花费，记入表格，与教材 6.6 节核对。
Read T*, C(T*), C(T) at 500 h and the run-to-failure cost; record them and check against Section 6.6.
点“生产时间停机保养”预置（C_p = $815），记录 T* 和 C(T*) 的变化。
Press “stop during production” (C_p = $815) and record how T* and C(T*) change.
把 C_p 依次设为 $100、$400、$1,500，各记一次 T*，画出 T* 随 C_p 变化的趋势。
Set C_p to $100, $400 and $1,500 in turn, recording T* each time, and sketch how T* changes with C_p.
点“β = 1 对照”，看曲线是否还有最低点。
Press “β = 1 check” and see whether the curve still has a minimum.
恢复“下班后保养”，把 T 设在 T* 附近，点“播放”跑到 20,000 h，记下两台设备的平均每小时花费，与 C(T) 比较。
Restore “service after shift”, set T near T*, play to 20,000 h and record both machines’ average hourly cost; compare with C(T).
点“换一串随机数”再跑一次，看结果差多少。
Press “New random numbers”, run again and see how much the result changes.

Table 2  Optimal interval for different service costs

questions: 为什么保养越便宜，最优周期越短？用 C(T) 的分子分母解释。
Why does a cheaper service mean a shorter optimal interval? Explain with the numerator and denominator of C(T).
曲线在 T* 附近很平，这对实际定周期有什么好处？
The curve is flat near T*. Why is that convenient in practice?
模拟跑出的平均花费和 C(T) 不完全一样，为什么？跑得越久会怎样？
The simulated average differs a little from C(T). Why, and what happens as the run gets longer?

title: 实验 18 设备维护策略：保养时机的决策
Lab 18 Maintenance strategy: timing preventive maintenance
作业 6：保养时机与保养周期
Assignment 6: when to service and how often
tasks: 计算题（教材习题 2、3）。(1) GRD-01 拖到 800 h 才处理，求未来 80 运行小时坏掉的概率和预期损失。(2) 数控车床 CNC-L01-A：β = 2.5，η = 1,400 h，已运行 700 h；坏一次停 240 分钟、修理 $700，停机每小时少挣 $60；保养停 120 分钟，人工 $45/h，材料 $80。求未来 80 h 坏掉的概率、预期损失和保养花费，判断现在保养是否划算，说明与 GRD-01 结论不同的原因。

Calculation (textbook exercises 2 and 3). (1) If GRD-01 is left until 800 h, find the probability of failing in the next 80 operating hours and the expected loss. (2) CNC lathe CNC-L01-A: β = 2.5, η = 1,400 h, run 700 h; a failure stops it for 240 minutes and costs $700, and an hour stopped loses $60; a service takes 120 minutes at $45/h plus $80 of materials. Find the probability of failing in the next 80 h, the expected loss and the service cost; decide whether servicing now pays and explain why the answer differs from GRD-01's.

Design (textbook exercise 4). Use C(T) to find the optimal age-based interval for CNC-L01-A (C_p = $170, C_f = $940) and compare it with the current 600 h; check with Virtual lab 6-2 and attach a screenshot.

Lab report: complete digital-factory Lab 18 and write up, using the template, your hand calculation, the comparison of options, your choice against the hub's recommendation, the whole service process, the comparison and MTBF, and the discussion questions.

One PDF: full working for the calculation and design tasks (with screenshots) plus the Lab 18 report (using the digital factory's template, 6–10 pages).

Calculation: correct probability, expected loss and service cost, with a reasoned decision, 30 points

Design: correct C(T) and optimum, with a sound comparison to the current interval, 20 points

text: 浴盆曲线的哪一段，定期预防性保养最有用？
In which phase of the bathtub curve does scheduled preventive maintenance help most?
磨损失效段，失效率随时间上升
Wear-out, where the failure rate rises with time
早期失效段，失效率随时间下降
Infant mortality, where the failure rate falls
偶然失效段，失效率大致不变
Random failures, where the rate is roughly constant
三段一样有用
All three phases equally

feedback: 保养把设备拨回失效率低的状态，只有失效率随时间上升时才有好处；早期失效段拆装反而可能引入新问题。
Service puts the machine back where the failure rate is low, which only helps when the rate rises with time; in infant mortality, dismantling can introduce new faults.

text: 威布尔分布中，不论 β 取何值，t = η 时累计故障概率 F 等于：
In the Weibull distribution, whatever β is, the cumulative failure probability at t = η is:
取决于 β
It depends on β

feedback: F(η) = 1 − exp(−1^β) = 1 − e⁻¹ = 63.2%. 50% is the median life and 36.8% is R(η).

text: 某设备的 β = 0.7。下列做法哪个最合理？
A machine has β = 0.7. Which is the most sensible approach?
加强出厂试车和验收，避免频繁拆装
Strengthen run-in and acceptance tests and avoid frequent dismantling
缩短保养周期
Shorten the service interval
保养周期定为 η
Set the interval to η
每天保养一次
Service it every day

feedback: β < 1 是早期失效，失效率随时间下降，越用越可靠；频繁保养（拆装）反而可能把设备拨回失效率高的状态。
β < 1 means infant mortality: the failure rate falls and the machine becomes more reliable with use; frequent service can push it back to a high failure rate.

text: 外圆磨床 GRD-01：β = 3，η = 900 h。刚保养完，运行到 400 h 之前坏掉的概率是百分之几？
Grinder GRD-01: β = 3, η = 900 h. Right after a service, what is the probability (in percent) that it fails before 400 h?
GRD-01（β = 3，η = 900 h）自上次保养已运行 300 h。再运行 80 h 内坏掉的概率是百分之几？
GRD-01 (β = 3, η = 900 h) has run 300 h since its last service. What is the probability (in percent) that it fails within the next 80 h?
接上题，GRD-01 坏一次损失 $2,800。不保养，未来 80 h 的预期损失是多少美元？
Continuing: one failure of GRD-01 costs $2,800. Without service, what is the expected loss in dollars over the next 80 h?
feedback: 预期损失 = 3.75% × 2,800 ≈ $105，比一次保养的 $215 少，这时还不必提前保养。
Expected loss = 3.75% × 2,800 ≈ $105, less than a $215 service, so no early service is needed yet.

text: β = 1 时，已运行 600 h 的设备和刚保养完的设备，未来 80 h 坏掉的概率相同。
For β = 1, a machine that has run 600 h and one just serviced have the same probability of failing in the next 80 h.
feedback: β = 1 时 P(t, H) = 1 − e^(−H/η)，与 t 无关（无记忆性），所以定期保养不降低风险。
For β = 1, P(t, H) = 1 − e^(−H/η), independent of t (memorylessness), so scheduled service does not reduce the risk.

text: 对按龄保养的最优周期 T*，下列说法正确的是：
Which statements about the optimal age-based interval T* are correct?
保养成本 C_p 越低，T* 越短
The lower the service cost C_p, the shorter T*
一次故障损失 C_f 越大，T* 越短
The larger the failure loss C_f, the shorter T*
β ≤ 1 时没有有限的最优周期
For β ≤ 1 there is no finite optimum
T* 总是等于 η
T* always equals η
T* 越短越好
The shorter T* the better

feedback: C_p 相对 C_f 越小，越值得勤保养；β ≤ 1 时 C(T) 单调下降；T* 由 β、η、C_p、C_f 共同决定，GRD-01 的 T* 是 312 h 或 535 h，都不等于 η。
The smaller C_p is relative to C_f, the more often service pays; for β ≤ 1, C(T) only falls; T* depends on β, η, C_p and C_f together; for GRD-01 it is 312 h or 535 h, not η.

text: 某设备近 30 天、每天 16 运行小时，共故障 4 次。MTBF 约多少小时？
A machine ran 16 hours a day for 30 days and failed 4 times. Roughly what is its MTBF in hours?
feedback: MTBF ≈ 30 × 16 ÷ 4 = 120 h。它只是平均数，看不出失效率是升是降。
MTBF ≈ 30 × 16 ÷ 4 = 120 h. It is only an average and does not show whether the failure rate is rising.

text: GRD-01 保养逾期，三个方案的预期合计：不做 $375，现在保养 $817，下班后保养 $235。现在保养贵的主要原因是：
GRD-01 is overdue; the expected totals are: do nothing $375, service now $817, service after the shift $235. Why is servicing now so expensive?
瓶颈在生产时间里停 3 小时，少挣约 $600 毛利
The bottleneck stops for 3 hours of production, losing about $600 of margin
保养人工比下班后贵
Labour costs more than after the shift
保养后失效率反而上升
The failure rate rises after service
现在保养后 80 h 内坏掉的概率更高
After servicing now, the chance of failing in 80 h is higher

feedback: 两种保养的人工和材料都是 $215，保养后风险都只剩约 0.07%；差别在于现在保养占用瓶颈的生产时间。
Both services cost $215 in labour and materials and leave about 0.07% risk; the difference is that servicing now takes production time from the bottleneck.

text: GRD-01（β = 3，η = 900 h）已运行 800 h。再运行 80 h 内坏掉的概率是百分之几？
GRD-01 (β = 3, η = 900 h) has run 800 h. What is the probability (in percent) that it fails within the next 80 h?
GRD-01 的 MTTF = η·Γ(1 + 1/β)，β = 3，η = 900 h，Γ(4/3) ≈ 0.893。MTTF 约多少小时？
For GRD-01, MTTF = η·Γ(1 + 1/β) with β = 3, η = 900 h and Γ(4/3) ≈ 0.893. Roughly what is the MTTF in hours?
数字工厂把可靠性系数设为“加速 ×5”时，算概率前 t 和 H 都乘 5。GRD-01（β = 3，η = 900 h）运行了 100 h，再运行 20 h 内坏掉的概率是百分之几？

With the digital factory's reliability factor at “accelerated ×5”, both t and H are multiplied by 5. GRD-01 (β = 3, η = 900 h) has run 100 h. What is the probability (in percent) that it fails within the next 20 h?
按龄保养的 C(T) 中，分母 ∫₀ᵀ R(t) dt 的含义是：
In the age-based C(T), the denominator ∫₀ᵀ R(t) dt is:
一个保养周期的平均运行时间
The mean operating time of one cycle
周期内坏掉的概率
The probability of failing in a cycle
周期内的平均失效率
The mean failure rate in a cycle
一个周期的期望花费
The expected cost of a cycle

feedback: 周期在 T 和故障时刻中先到的那个结束，其平均长度是 R(t) 从 0 到 T 的积分；分子才是期望花费。
A cycle ends at T or at a failure, whichever comes first; its mean length is the integral of R(t) from 0 to T. The numerator is the expected cost.

text: 学生按中枢建议做了保养，同期另一台逾期设备没保养也没坏，这说明保养是多余的。
A student serviced a machine as the hub advised, and another overdue machine was not serviced and did not fail. This shows the service was unnecessary.
feedback: 一次结果不能检验概率决策；13% 的风险意味着多数时候不坏。策略好坏要看很多次的平均。
A single outcome cannot test a probabilistic decision; a 13% risk means it usually does not fail. A policy is judged by its average over many runs.

key: 威布尔分布与 β、η 的含义；条件故障概率与预期损失；三个方案的比较；按龄保养的最优周期。
The Weibull distribution and the meaning of β and η; conditional failure probability and expected loss; comparing three options; the optimal age-based interval.
difficult: 为什么决策要用条件概率而不是 F(t)；期望值与单次结果的区别；C(T) 的分母为什么是 ∫R dt；保养成本如何影响最优周期。
Why decisions need the conditional probability rather than F(t); expectation versus a single outcome; why the denominator of C(T) is ∫R dt; how the service cost moves the optimum.

content: 展示厂情中枢的“保养逾期”异常和两种意见，提出本讲的问题。
Show the hub's “service overdue” exception and the two opinions; pose the questions.

phase: 概念：浴盆曲线与威布尔分布
content: 三个阶段；F、R、h 与 β、η；用虚拟实验 6-1 现场拖参数。
Three phases; F, R, h, β and η; drag the parameters live in Virtual lab 6-1.

phase: 建模：条件概率、预期损失与三个方案
Modelling: conditional probability, expected loss, three options
content: 推导 P(t, H)，手算 GRD-01；β = 1 对照；三个方案对比表。
Derive P(t, H) and calculate GRD-01 by hand; the β = 1 check; the table of three options.
C(T) 的含义与最优周期；虚拟实验 6-2 演示两条曲线和模拟比赛；MTBF 与概率、单次结果的区别。
Meaning of C(T) and its optimum; demonstrate both curves and the race in Virtual lab 6-2; MTBF and probability versus one outcome.
学生手算逾期设备的概率与预期损失并提交；在指挥台比较三个方案、写理由提交（比对模式）。老师巡视，批准动作。

Students calculate the overdue machine's probability and expected loss and submit; compare the three options in the command centre and submit reasons (comparison mode). The instructor circulates and approves actions.
采纳方案、生成保养工单、老师批准；挂牌上锁、保养、验收解锁，核对 ERPNext 保养记录。
Adopt an option, raise the service order, get approval; lockout, service, acceptance and unlocking; check the ERPNext service record.
调快倍速让车间运行，统计保养与未保养设备的故障次数，估 MTBF；完成虚拟实验 6-1、6-2 的记录表。
Speed up the shop, count failures on serviced and unserviced machines, estimate MTBF; complete the record tables of Virtual labs 6-1 and 6-2.
对照中枢建议讨论各组的选择与结果，强调概率与单次结果的区别；布置作业。
Discuss each group's choice and outcome against the hub's advice, stressing probability versus one outcome; set the assignment.
